narr: A few thunderstorms produced damaging winds in Runnels and Sutton counties and localized flash flooding in Taylor County.
ev: Media reported there were water rescues at N 18th Street and Treadway Boulevard, N 10th Street and Westmoreland Street, and along S 1st Street. People were helped out of vehicles in high water.
